changeSet.author: osmontero
changeSet.comment: Fix 6 coordinate-map visualizations that bucket on origin.ip.keyword. The origin.ip field is typed 'ip' in the index template, which has NO .keyword sub-field, so the terms bucket is always empty and the map renders blank. The map mechanism (RequestDsl.java) then attaches a _geo_hit topHits agg pulling origin.geolocation.lat/lng per bucket. Switching the bucket field to the bare 'origin.ip' (an 'ip' field aggregates directly) makes the maps render. Verified on lab: aws=Spain, google=Canada, netflow/pfsense=US points. The 6 viz are compliance-pinned dashboards; this is an additive field correction (no id renumber/delete), so compliance rendering is preserved. Idempotent: re-running sets the same field.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE utm_visualization SET aggregation = jsonb_set(aggregation::jsonb, '{bucket,field}', to_jsonb('origin.ip'::text))::text WHERE id IN (127,522,55,573,532,510) AND aggregation::text LIKE '%origin.ip.keyword%';
